theorems.name: Submission.dohr_lmo_carrier_support_null
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (O : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet O → O ⊆ U → (∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ O)), y ∉ V.carrier → V.HasDensity y 0) → (∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ O, ∃ Θ : ℝ, 1 ≤ Θ ∧ V.HasDensity y Θ) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (V.carrier ∩ O) (V.support ∩ O)) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
